ID2.speaker: player
ID2.text: ehem, I mean, today is a great day to play.

ID3.speaker: narrator
ID3.text: You always start the morning with your yarn ball, it's ragged and old, but it's what makes the day awesome for you.

ID4.speaker: narrator
ID4.text: The sun is barely out and because you are such a wrecking ball of energy and noise and fluffy hair and cute ears (and whatever else you are), you wake up the whole neighborhood.

ID5.speaker: narrator
ID5.text: Humans yell at you from their windows, but you don't speak human, so you do not care at all.

ID6.speaker: narrator
ID6.text: This commotion and protagonist time of yours, catches the eye of a dark mysterious figure.

ID7.speaker: narrator
ID7.text:
While you go crazy, time stops and a dark cat appears before you.
Your instincs kick in and you stop playing to study the new creature before you.

ID8.speaker: player
ID8.text: mmm Excuse me, eh, good sir? Do you need something?

ID9.speaker: kronos
ID9.text:
*stares into the distance* oh Yes, you see there's a buch of meat in the corner of this alley.
I was thinking if I should go eat it

ID10.speaker: narrator
ID10.text: At the mention of food, your brain knows no better than your stomach, both empty. You turn around naively all excited for food but find nothing.

ID11.speaker: player
ID11.text: That's weird, I don't see anything, sir.

ID12.speaker: kronos
ID12.text: *smirks* oh yeah, sorry I was thinking of a different alley. Anyway I see you're sooo intelligent my friend, so let's do this: you see this thing?

ID13.speaker: kronos
ID13.text:
He points to your yarn ball.
If you bring me that meat from the alley I was thinking of, I'll give you this thing in return.

ID14.speaker: narrator
ID14.text: kronos suddenly makes YOUR yarn ball appear next to him, while you were distracted he took the opportunity to stole it.

ID15.speaker: player
ID15.text: *in pure disbelief* YOU!! How do you have my yarn ball!?

ID16.speaker: kronos
ID16.text: Oh well the hows and whats aren't important here my friend, the thing is *pauses* I'm not giving it back to you MUAHAHA *evil laugh*.

ID17.speaker: player
ID17.text:
you rat!... No, scratch that, you are even worse than a rat! 
 give it back or else!

ID18.speaker: kronos
ID18.text: first, don't compare me to filthy rats. I'm above that AND above you too. But I'll let it slide this time. You see, I'm a really generous creature that means no harm.

ID19.speaker: kronos
ID19.text: so I guess if you insist, I have no other option but to offer you a deal. Everything goes back to last week, when I accidentally and tragically lost my most priced belongings.

ID20.speaker: kronos
ID20.text: the thing is, I need someone to recover them. Don't worry it's only three objects, no biggie for something as smart as you.

ID21.speaker: player
ID21.text: why can't you do it yourself, if you want them back soooo badly?

ID22.speaker: kronos
ID22.text: because I can't, it's more complicated than that you peasant!

ID23.speaker: player
ID23.text: ugh, alr so what do I have to do to recover them so I can get my yarn back?

ID24.speaker: kronos
ID24.text: Pretty easy! you only have to win three games.

ID25.speaker: player
ID25.text:
against you? and can I choose the games?
 (with all his ego I guess he will be an easy opponent).

ID26.speaker: kronos
ID26.text: Oh no no, you? playing against the almighty kronos? no, no that can't be, I don't play with brats. Besides I don't have the objects duh if you win against me you would gain nothing.

ID27.speaker: kronos
ID27.text: *sighs* what you have to do is win against some of my *ehem* friends, who happened to recover them for me. However, for reasons you little brain won't understand I can't ask them to return them.

ID28.speaker: kronos
ID28.text: Anyway, win the games, I get my objects back and you get your beloved yarn. Do we have a deal?

ID29.speaker: player
ID29.text: (He seems shaddy, but I really want my yarn back ugh). Alr, we have a deal

ID30.speaker: narrator
ID30.text: kronos and you, paw with paw together and a there's a faint glow that goes away as fast as it came, this mean the deal has been sealed.

ID31.speaker: kronos
ID31.text: Well, it's done, but first you have to get with me in my box, this is how we will get around.

ID32.speaker: player
ID32.text: The box? how are we supposed to get around in that junk?

ID33.speaker: kronos
ID33.text: Oh, just shut it and get on!

ID34.speaker: narrator
ID34.text: you get reluctantly in the box, and when you're inside, you're shocked to see it has a lot more space than it appeared to have from the outside.

end.speaker: kronos
end.text: Well, welcome to my 'little' home haha. Now, because I'm the kindest cat around here, I'll let you choose where you wanna go first.
